site.derivation_note: IA Exhibit C-1 one-line diagram names two named AEP stations (Bluff Creek Station ~35mi, Red Creek Station ~15mi from AEP's Odysseus Station) plus IA Exhibit C text ('~19 miles northeast of San Angelo'). Cross-referenced against OpenGridMap transnet-models csv_nodes.csv (raw OSM-derived infra data, not a banned aggregator): San Angelo Red Creek Substation (AEP 345/138kV) at 31.5290977,-100.3212098. Computed distance from factsheet's independent EIA-860M plant coordinate (BNB Tennyson Solar LLC, plant 69605) to that substation = 13.87 mi (IA said ~15 mi) and to San Angelo = 20.4 mi at bearing 027 deg NNE (IA said ~19 mi NE) -- two independent geometric checks converge on the EIA coordinate within ~1-1.5 mi. NOT a county centroid -- county is ~1800 sq km.

evidence: No Sentinel-2 imagery obtained this run: root-caused via raw curl to openEO /result endpoint -- HTTP 402 Payment Required, 'You do not have sufficient credits to perform this request' (marketplace-portal.dataspace.copernicus.eu/pages/pricing). Shared CDSE account credits exhausted, almost certainly by 4+ concurrent research-agent sessions in this container each pulling chips. Not retryable with backoff -- hard account-level blocker, logged for the pipeline operator.
Independent of imagery: Akuo's own project page (sources/2026-07-20_akuoenergy_tennyson-project-page.html) states current status 'in construction' with up to 400 workers/subcontractors on site
EIA-860M (factsheet.json, plant 69605): status '(U) Under construction, less than or equal [to 50%]' as of the latest 860M snapshot

First Amended and Restated IA executed 2025-10-01 with an INCREASED $28.5M security posting (vs $19.0M original) and a finalized equipment change to Sungrow SG4400UD-MV inverters -- consistent with active late-stage engineering/procurement, not a stalled project

reasoning_evidence: Queue-reported COD 2027-03-02 has held stable for 9 consecutive monthly snapshots (2025-10-01 -> 2026-06-01, per timeline.md) -- the longest stable hold in the project's 86-snapshot history (prior holds ranged 2-14 months with 7 total revisions) -- and that stabilization window begins exactly at the First Amended and Restated IA's execution date (2025-10-01), consistent with the amendment (not a fresh unilateral slip) being the last schedule reset

The amended IA's Exhibit B schedule is FLOATING (months-from-conditions-satisfied, not a fixed calendar date) and neither IA document states the trigger date, so the contractual COD cannot be read directly off the IA text -- this is a genuine limit, not resolved this run

EIA-860M second source (eia_history.json): planned COD 2026-12 (3 months EARLIER than the queue's 2027-03-02) sustained across all 5 reported months (2026-01 -> 2026-05); status 'Under construction, <=50% complete' sustained the same 5 months -- independent confirmation of active construction, though EIA's status band means more than half the work likely remains as of 2026-05

Independent (non-imagery) confirmation of active construction: Akuo's own project page states current status 'in construction' with up to 400 workers/subcontractors on site (sources/2026-07-20_akuoenergy_tennyson-project-page.html)

Financing/counterparty strength: two credit-worthy PPA offtakers under 15-yr contracts (Sasol 91MW VPPA, Imerys 57MW PPA, both announced/signed 2025-06) and a PE-backed parent (Ardian, 100% owner of Akuo Group as of 2025-07-04) -- reduces cancellation risk relative to a paper/speculative filing

Risk factors: 7 prior COD slips over the project's history (2021-11 original claim -> current 2027-03, ~64 months of cumulative delay); financial security more than doubled between IA versions ($19.0M -> $28.5M), and the equipment vendor changed (Power Electronics -> Sungrow) alongside the capacity tweak (150.0->151.2MW) -- normal late-engineering activity but adds execution risk; no satellite imagery obtained this run (CDSE account credit-exhausted) so construction PACE could not be independently visually verified

Net: EIA's earlier Dec-2026 planned date and the queue's own newly-stabilized Mar-2027 date bracket a plausible COD window; splitting toward the queue's more recent/higher-security-backed figure with modest slippage risk given the historical pattern -> independent estimate 2027-Q2, drift risk medium

contractual_schedule.note: This IA uses Option 4.1.A (TSP designs/builds) with a FLOATING schedule keyed to the date all Sec. 4.2/4.3 conditions are satisfied (Facilities Study complete + Generator authorization + security posted) — neither IA document states that trigger's calendar date, so the contractual COD cannot be read directly off the IA text (unlike Hanson's fixed-date schedule). Equipment also changed between documents: original specified Power Electronics FS4200M-HEM GEN3 inverters (39x4.2MW, 163.8MW nominal); amendment specifies Sungrow SG4400UD-MV (37x4.0865MW, 151.2MW nominal at 34.5kV bus / 150MW at POI) — consistent with the queue's 150.0->151.2 MW capacity bump recorded 2025-05.
